scope: review of c6e11921 P1 fix; read-only; no source/test/config/git/provider changes
reason: The original 64-char long-name P1 is closed for names >64 at start/after Chinese prose. A new P1 remains: when the declaration is still clipped at the 4096 cap, find_product_declarations silently omits it and reference_closure returns missing instead of partial. The 107 tests do not cover this defer path.

original_p1.evidence: test_long_latin_name_is_never_truncated_by_the_lookbehind; direct probe returns full four-token family
continue omits declaration; closure returns missing

new_p1.title: 4096-cap clipped declaration is silently omitted and becomes missing

repro.declaration: 公司推出 NaN NaN NaN NaN 系列产品。
repro.target: 该系列产品已交付客户。

new_p1.impact: A real declaration clipped at the max window is treated as absent; downstream returns missing rather than partial/defer. This violates the rule that truncated/unknown windows must not infer absence.
new_p1.fix: Return a clipped/deferred status from find_product_declarations or a separate status channel; map any required clipped declaration to partial with antecedent_window_clipped; add a >4096-name deictic test; rerun CN/HK/US and CI.
